author: Scott Manley
description:
Trying to figure out what we know and what conclusions we can draw, for now we know that ULA's Vulcan failed to reach orbit and the data we have points toa problem with the first stage core which ran long and never gave the second stage the lift it needed to reach orbit.

author: Scott Manley
description:
Flight 15 was supposed to include the first V3 booster recovery, the first really long duration Starship flight, and, the first Starship catch. Well they didn't catch the booster, but 2 out of 3 ain't bad.
